qualification: firsthand K7222/ÜHA78 variant comparison; monitor revision and installed .11 winding graph not identified; compatibility reread against corrected .11 V21 pads

observations.reading: The computer-monitor ÜHA78 has two coil assemblies, one on each core leg; the Combivision TV version has one. This is a repairer's variant description, not a factory drawing.
Only three leads of the yellow coil are used in the computer monitor, with the rest provided by the red coil. The post does not identify a .11 pin map.

The writer identifies X1-side L3/L4/L5 including the HV winding as the ÜHA78 and X2-side L1/L2 as the external primary assembly in the schematic he discusses. His TV ÜHA78 has X1:1 bridged to X1:2 and X1:7 connected to X2:3; he says the TV wiring must be changed for the computer monitor. The discussed monitor revision is unstated.

compatibility_with_k7222_11.required_external_v21_path: V21 anode X3:1, cathode X3:2/EHT; the separate X1:1 and X1:2 labels are magnetic terminals
compatibility_with_k7222_11.tv_x1_1_x1_2_bridge: not excluded by the V21 path: the diode is on X3:1/X3:2, but a TV-variant bridge is not evidence that the .11 part contains it
compatibility_with_k7222_11.tv_x1_7_x2_3_bridge: not transferred: the post assigns this link to a TV variant and gives no .11 monitor pin map
compatibility_with_k7222_11.monitor_x1_2_x2_3_conductor: the .11 page-4 drawing joins these external terminals; the TV post does not prove any further internal continuity

effect_on_a5: Do not transfer the TV bridges to the .11 candidate. The earlier V21-bypass reason for excluding X1:1-X1:2 was wrong because V21 is on X3:1/X3:2. The .11 internal bridge state is unqualified; no turns, polarity or core-loss bound follows from this account.
